conbody.p: Every page is framed the same way: a narrow rail down the left and one top bar across the top, so the work itself gets the rest of the screen. The frame is the same inside a project and on the workspace's own pages (Projects, workspace settings, workspace runs, What's new and platform admin); only the rail's buttons change.

ul.li:
The top bar reads left to right: the workspace switcher, the project switcher, the search across every project, Help, the notification bell and the account menu.
Switch workspace: click the workspace's name for the list of your workspaces, workspace settings and runs, and creating a company workspace.
Switch project: click the project's name (it reads All projects on a workspace page) for the workspace's projects. Choose one to open it at its Overview; All projects opens the Projects page and + New project starts a project from wherever you are.

The rail inside a project has a button for each part of the project, in the order the work runs — Plan, Define and Verify — then, below a rule, Agents and links to Activity, Settings and, for platform admins, Admin. Click a group to open its pages beside the rail (Plan holds Overview, Board, Gantt and Releases, for example), then click the page. The group holding the page you are on is marked. The list closes when you arrive, or with Esc or a click anywhere else.

The row under the top bar lists the pages of the group you are in, with the one you are reading underlined, so the page next door is one click away. It is where a page is named: the page itself does not repeat its name. Activity and Settings belong to no group, so they have no row.

The rail on a workspace page is laid out the same way: Home; Plan, which holds every project's plan (All projects) and what is yours across them (My tasks and To-dos); then Agents, which holds the workspace's agents and their Runs, Settings, and Admin for platform admins. The row under the top bar lists the pages of the group you are in, as inside a project. What's new is not in the rail: a release reaches you as a notification, and its notes are in your account menu and beside the release in the workspace's settings.
Home is at the top of the rail on every page and opens the workspace's Home: what needs you across every project, the workspace's activity, and its projects to choose from.

conbody.p: On a phone there is no rail. On a workspace page the top bar holds the workspace switcher above the project switcher, with help, the bell and your account beside them. Inside a project the top bar names the project, and a bar along the bottom reads Home, Plan, Define, Verify, More from left to right: the same groups in the same order as the rail on a computer. A group's tab opens the page you last read in that group, and the row under the top bar lists the group's other pages (swipe it sideways when it is wider than the screen). More is the whole menu as a page of its own: the workspace switcher, the project switcher and the search, then every page as a tile under its group, Help for the page you were on, the Manual, All projects, and under You your account menu. The same bar stays under a workspace page: Home is the workspace's Home, a group's tab opens the project you last opened at the page you last read in that group (it is greyed until you have opened a project), and More lists the workspace's own pages.

A form that opens as a dialog on a computer (recording evidence, launching a run, the download wizard) takes the whole screen on a phone: its title stays at the top beside ✕, which closes it, and its fields scroll underneath. A short question, such as a confirmation, stays a small card. Every page keeps the same margin from the edge of the screen.
